Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Rajesh Kumar Chaubey, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Ms.Suman Kumari Singh,APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR VERMA  ORAL ORDER 4 13-09-2024 Heard Mr.Rajesh Kumar Chaubey, learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms.Suman Kumari Singh,learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks bail, who is in custody since 24.03.2024 in connection with Complaint Case No. 158(C) of 2020, F.I.R. dated 31.01.2020 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 406,420,379,504 of IPC and Section 138 of NI Act.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in the present case.

The allegation as alleged in the complaint petition is false and fabricated and the complainant is sister of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.48594 of 2024(4)
dt.13-09-2024 petitioner and although the petitioner has returned all the amounts as mentioned in the complaint petition to the complainant but according to her, some amount is still pending to return back to the complainant and learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that the petitioner is ready to settle the dispute with the complainant and for this purpose petitioner may be Anand Shankar Tiwary vs The State Of Bihar on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152280187/
1 released on provisional bail for a period of eight weeks.

sentences.text:
4. Considering the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner, let the petitioner, above named, be released on provisional bail for a period of eight weeks on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-V, Danapur, Patna in connection with Complaint Case No.
158(C) of 2020, with the following conditions:-
(I) Petitioner shall co-operate in the trial and shall be properly represented on each and every date fixed by the Court and shall remain physically present as directed by the Court and on his/her absence on two consecutive dates without sufficient reason,
his/her bail bond shall be cancelled by the Court below.

(II) If the petitioner tampers with the evidence or the witnesses, in that case, the prosecution will be at liberty to move Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.48594 of 2024(4) dt.13-09-2024 for cancellation of bail.

(III) And, further condition that the court below shall verify the criminal antecedent of the petitioner and in case at any stage, it is found that the petitioner has concealed his criminal antecedent, the court below shall take step for cancellation of bail bond of the petitioner.
However, the acceptance of bail bonds in terms of the above-mentioned order shall not be delayed for purpose of or in the name of verification.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to contact the complainant, who is sister of the petitioner, and settle the dispute by fixing a meeting.
6. Re-notify after three months i.e. on 20.12.2024.

(Rajesh Kumar Verma, J) Nitesh/-
